name: Official and explainable investigation path
description: Verifies evaluator presets use the real backend engine and preserve OFFICIAL, HIGH, and LOW outcomes with explainable evidence.
steps: Open Investigations and run Official PayNova
Close the evidence drawer and run PayNоva Support
Close the drawer and run Pavel Novak
expected: Official PayNova is OFFICIAL without threat scoring, PayNоva Support is HIGH with homoglyph evidence, and Pavel Novak is LOW.

name: Custom candidate validation and analysis
description: Verifies invalid custom input is blocked and a valid suspicious candidate is analyzed by the backend risk engine.
steps: Open Investigations and submit the empty evaluator-controlled form
Enter PayNova Account Recovery, paynova_recovery_team, Account Help Desk, URGENT click the link and login to verify your PayNova account, and https://paynova-account-check.example.org
expected: Required-field validation appears first; the valid suspicious candidate then produces a clearly elevated backend result in the evidence drawer.

name: Persisted fixture detection to incident lifecycle
description: Verifies the core fixture scan, detection filtering, incident creation, analyst transition, false-positive decision, and refresh persistence workflow.
steps: In Detections filter to HIGH and FIXTURE, investigate a result, then create an incident
Move the NEW incident to INVESTIGATING, mark it FALSE POSITIVE, and refresh the page
expected: The scan and incident survive refresh, provenance remains FIXTURE, and the FALSE POSITIVE decision remains in incident history.

name: Apple live provenance and fallback truthfulness
description: Verifies Apple is the only live source and that successful, empty, and unavailable upstream outcomes are represented truthfully.
steps: Review the resulting status and provenance in Detections or Analytics
expected: A successful Apple request is LIVE even with zero results; only an actual upstream failure is labelled FALLBACK and shown with a warning.

name: Mobile brand configuration and operational navigation
description: Verifies the compact workspace navigation remains usable on mobile and protected brand configuration persists through the real API.
steps: Open the mobile navigation and go to Brand Assets
Confirm the protected brand profile and save it
Navigate to Dashboard and Analytics using the mobile sidebar
expected: Navigation does not cause page-level horizontal overflow, the protected brand saves through the backend, and Dashboard and Analytics remain usable.
